title: NSA classified internal network disrupted
summary: A classified NSA network was disrupted. The agency attributed network degradation to scheduled maintenance. An intrusion has not been established.
connection: No validated public technical connection with FAA, Microsoft, Chase, or Optimizely.

title: Optimizely scripts compromised across 178 organizations
summary: Malicious JavaScript appeared in customer website projects. Reported capabilities included credential theft, crypto wallet hijacking, and mobile exploit targeting. Victim impact under investigation.
connection: A compromised shared technology supplier explains the cross-site exposure, but does not establish connection to other infrastructure outages.

title: Chase processing incident affects transactions
summary: Banking transaction disruption affected payments and transfers, reportedly with downstream effects at other banks. Cyber intrusion has not been demonstrated.
connection: Cross-bank processing dependencies can propagate outages; not evidence of one attacker.

title: United Airlines departure system disrupted
summary: A technology problem delayed flight departures. United attributed the problem to a software issue.
connection: Distinct incident from November 13 FAA ground stop.

title: FAA telecommunications failure causes ground stop
summary: Network and communications disruption caused a nationwide ground stop. Published explanations cite equipment and network instability; no verified cyberattack identified.
connection: No matching compromise indicators publicly demonstrated for other incidents.

title: Microsoft 365 enterprise service disruption
summary: Users reported disruption to multiple Microsoft 365 services. Available reporting describes internal software/network faults rather than a verified compromise.
connection: No publicly established common malicious cause with FAA, banking or NSA outages.
